messages:
Jordan R: FYI I started a lightweight migration PR to switch our function-calling docs to the new structured-output schema. Main changes: rename top-level keys, add explicit `required` suggestions for tools used by routing, and a short `migration` section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4388 :eyes:
Priya S: Nice. Can you paste the new example shape here? I want to update the SDK snippets afterwards.
Jordan R: Example I added:
```json
{
  "request_id": "req_123",
  "toolOutput": {"choices": [{"id":"c1","score":0.87}], "metadata": {"version":"v2"}},
  "confidence": 0.87
}
```
Ethan M: Noted. Two small asks: 1) show an example where tool returns either `choices` OR `error` (union array case) 2) document parse fallback: validate -> fallback to `original_text` field.
Priya S: I'll update the SDK snippets to reference `res.toolOutput` instead of `res.tool_result`. Also adding a migration note: older clients can check `res.tool_result || res.toolOutput`.
lisa-docs-bot: lint checks passing for PR 4388 (docs lint).
Jordan R: Good call on backwards compat snippet. I added a short code sample for that: `const output = res.toolOutput ?? res.tool_result;`
links-ci: Link check failed: https://docs.redwood.ai/specs/tool-schema -> 404.
Jordan R: Ack link CI. New canonical schema URL is https://docs.redwood.ai/schemas/structured-output-2025.json — updating PR.
Priya S: For guardrails section I recommend calling out required routing fields: `request_id` (string), `confidence` (number 0..1). Also say "avoid using percent integers".
Ethan M: Can we add an `example_response` block that SDK authors can copy into typegen? Something like:
```json
"example_response": {"request_id":"req_123","toolOutput":{"choices":[{"id":"c1","score":0.9}]},"confidence":0.9}
```
Jordan R: Added it. Also added a tiny nested-tool example where a tool returns another tool's output: `toolOutput: { nested: { toolOutput: {...} } }` with a note to flatten for SDK convenience.
Priya S: Leaving small wording nits in PR comments. Will push a commit to clarify "schema required fields are recommendations not enforcement" line.
Ethan M: One more runtime check: confirm `confidence` semantics (0..1 float). I asked eng-runtime in the PR.
jordan: merged locally for test renders, will wait for one docs review before merging to main.
Priya S: Pushed SDK updates and renamed examples. CI should re-run.
links-ci: Link check passed for updated URL.
lisa-docs-bot: PR 4388 -> docs build preview ready: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/4388/docs/tooling/structured-output-migration.html
Jordan R: Thanks everyone. If anyone wants to add more edge-case examples (nullable arrays, empty-choice responses), drop them here and I'll incorporate. :pray:
